data.notes: January’s confirmed calendar is anchored by the 42nd St Barth Music Festival, with a few high-season DJ events on Saint-Barthélemy and nearby French Saint-Martin.

events.title: Greg Cerrone at Bagatelle St Barth
events.summary: French-American DJ and producer Greg Cerrone was listed for a 9:00 PM AST set at Bagatelle St Barth in Gustavia. Bandsintown classifies the event with house, tech house, house disco and afro-tech tags.

events.title: Rainbow New Year’s Day: Francis Mercier
events.summary: Nearby on French Saint-Martin, Rainbow Café presented Francis Mercier with support from Nomis for a New Year’s Day beach-club session from 6:00 PM to 11:59 PM. Shotgun lists the moods as Afrobeat, deep house, house, electro and afro house.

events.title: Bob Sinclar x Coco Beach
events.summary: Nearby on French Saint-Martin, Coco Beach hosted Bob Sinclar for an early-night DJ set on Orient Bay Beach. The Shotgun listing describes the 4 January event as a house-focused beach party running 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM within the event window.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Paris Opera Ballet Opening Nights
events.summary: The 42nd St Barth Music Festival opened with dancers from the Paris Opera Ballet on 9 and 10 January at 7:30 PM. The listing names Amandine Albisson, Hannah O’Neill and Marc Moreau among the featured dancers.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Concert by Candlelight
events.summary: The festival scheduled a candlelight chamber concert at the Anglican Church in Gustavia on 13 January at 7:30 PM. The program was listed for violins, cello, viola, flute and piano.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Orchestral Evening with Delyana Lazarova
events.summary: The festival listed an orchestral evening at Lorient Church on 14 January at 7:30 PM under the direction of conductor Delyana Lazarova. The local program places it within the 42nd edition’s main classical series.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Chopin Piano Recital
events.summary: The festival programmed a Chopin piano recital at the Catholic Church in Gustavia on 15 January at 7:30 PM. The listed performers include pianist Alexej Gorlatch with Laura Frautschi, Christopher Wu, Francis Gouton, Nina Bernat and Rebecca Young.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Madame Butterfly Opera Evening
events.summary: The festival scheduled an opera evening built around Puccini’s “Madame Butterfly” at Lorient Church on 16 January at 8:00 PM. The performance was listed under the direction of conductor Mimma Campanale.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Angela Grey Quintet Jazz Concert
events.summary: Angela Grey Quintet was listed for a jazz concert at the Anglican Church in Gustavia on 17 January at 7:30 PM. The follow-up festival article names Grey’s accompanying musicians as Gustave Reichert, Luca Fattorini, Simon Chivallon and Malte Arndal.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Angela Grey Quintet Sunday Jazz Concert
events.summary: A second Angela Grey Quintet jazz concert was listed for the Anglican Church in Gustavia on 18 January at 6:00 PM. It was part of the St Barth Music Festival’s closing weekend program.

events.title: St Barth Music Festival: Brazilian Evening with Will Santt
events.summary: Brazilian guitarist, singer and songwriter Will Santt was listed to close the festival at the Anglican Church in Gustavia on 19 January at 7:30 PM. The article describes the closing program as bossa nova / “bossa novissima.”
